headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: The IRGC says an unnamed container ship sank after hitting a mine south of Hormuz, and a Houthi missile set fire to an Aramco office building in Dhahran. The sinking has no ship name or independent confirmation and the Dhahran hit took no export hub offline, so no tripwire fired and the odds hold.
